name: query_clinvar
description: Query ClinVar for variant clinical significance, associated conditions, and review status
usage: from app.tools.biomni.database_connectors import query_clinvar; result = query_clinvar('rs28897672')

parameters.variant_id: str — rs ID (e.g. 'rs28897672') or HGVS notation

returns: dict with keys: variant_id, clinical_significance, conditions (list), review_status, gene, source
